name: SAGE: Skills Acquisition through Gamified Experience. Intervention in Neurodevelopmental Disorders. Adquisición de habilidades mediante experiencias gamificadas. Intervención en trastornos del neurodesarrollo.
summary:
Platform developed within the I-TEACH work package of the European UNITE project (Erasmus+), designed to support the acquisition of cognitive and motor skills in children with neurodevelopmental disorders (Autism Spectrum Disorder, ADHD) through a gamified experience.
🏠 Bedroom – basic object classification
🛋️ Living Room – eight mini-games covering leisure and chained routines
🚿 Bathroom – personal hygiene routine
🍽️ Kitchen – food sequencing and executive function training
